text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "The German Section translates into German texts produced by the Federal Chancellery or for the Presidial Services, and checks the quality of translations produced for the federal authorities in the departments and offices.", "gist": "The German Section translates and quality-checks German texts for the Federal Chancellery and Presidial Services, and for federal authorities in departments and offices."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "It thereby contributes to the quality of multilingual official communication.", "gist": "The German Section improves the quality of multilingual official communication."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Rat für deutsche Rechtschreibung", "gist": "Rat für deutsche Rechtschreibung (Council for German Orthography)"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The German Section is active in national and international bodies that deal with language policy, for example the Rat für deutsche Rechtschreibung.", "gist": "The German Section participates in national and international language policy bodies, such as the Rat für deutsche Rechtschreibung."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "It contributes the Federal Administration’s position and represents the interests of Switzerland.", "gist": "The German Section presents the Federal Administration's stance and represents Switzerland's interests."}, {"type": "other", "quote": "Linguistic advice", "gist": "Linguistic advice (section title)"}]}
